user.title: Xiaomi Smart Jump Rope
user.description: Choose the rope. It only shows up while awake: jump or press its button.

method.title: Connect the rope
method.description: Pair the rope directly with Home Assistant (no phone needed), or reuse the credentials of an existing Mi Fitness pairing.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description:
The rope could not be paired: {error}

Wake the rope with a button press and try again.

credentials.title: Existing pairing
credentials.description: Enter the credentials of the existing Mi Fitness pairing of {name} (see the README).

progress.pair:
Press the **Power button** on the end of the rope's handle **once, now**.

Waiting up to a minute. If the rope reports being busy, this retries automatically (about 40 s).

error.invalid_app_device_id: The app device ID must be 32 hex characters
error.invalid_token: The token must be 32 hex characters

abort.no_devices_found: No jump rope found. Wake the rope (jump or press its button) and try again.
